items.title: 3M Cut Its Dividend After 64 Years of Raises. Is It Finally a Buy Again?
items.summary: 3M broke a 64-year streak, shed its forever-chemicals baggage, and just settled its biggest legal fight. Retirees now face a harder question: do the payout math, the cash drains, and two rival dividend payers justify trusting the company with income again?

items.title: What Is Solventum (SOLV) Signaling With Its 90% Separation And HIS Split Plan?
items.summary: Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) reports that more than 90% of its separation from former parent 3M is now complete. The healthcare supplier has executed its largest ever ERP cutover, consolidating core systems into a new standalone platform. Management has renegotiated a raw material supply agreement with 3M and plans to separate the Health Information Systems business for clearer focus. items.title: Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) beats Q3 2026 sales expectations
items.summary: Healthcare solutions provider Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, but revenue fell by 7% year on year to $1.95 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.45 per share was 7.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
